_README: REVIEWED announce-date corrections for docs/sf_fundamentals.json ann slots (annStd/annCon).
For the class neither existing ann mechanism reaches: a POPULATED ann that must move LATER.
ann_date_fills.json overrides are earlier-only by design (NSE-broadcast-lag, runbook 104);
its normal entries fill only ann==0. This ledger retires FABRICATED-EARLY dates - a qe+45d /
qe+60d default stamped on a pre-listing quarter whose value measurably was NOT public then
(runbook 99 / 108). Every entry must state the MEASUREMENT that dates first availability:
the filing (or single-document derivation) that first made the figure public, and the
measured absence of any earlier filing. Dates are stored GATED (runbook 12: next day for
post-15:30 broadcasts), because apply_ann_cell_fix.py writes the twins directly.
Applied by scripts/apply_ann_cell_fix.py --apply, guarded on `was` (empty slots always
writable). NOT wired into any workflow; nothing nightly rewrites these eras' ann slots
(measured: the P2 broadcast re-dates of 2026-08-23 survived subsequent nightlies unchanged).

fixes.why: Pre-listing quarter (first traded bar 2015-08-11; Syngene listed Aug-2015). The stored 20140814 is the qe+45d SEBI-deadline convention stamped by the FAV14 P4 applier - it fabricates a public date 12 months before the company had a tape or a filing. Measured first availability: the company's FIRST-EVER result filing (BSE ann 2015-10-20 19:14, the Sep-2015 results, CorpAttachment/2015/10/196A4865_E4EE_4EAD_9BF6_259895AF394F_191354.pdf) prints H1-FY15 YTD and Sep-2014 columns whose difference IS this quarter (NP 7,456-4,001=3,455 lakh = 34.55cr, the stored 34.6); no earlier BSE Result announcement exists for scrip 539268 (AnnSubCategoryGetData Result list starts 2015-10-20). Gated next-day = 20151021, same date the sibling Sep-2015 cell already carries.

Pre-listing quarter (first bar 2015-08-11); no own Mar-2015 filing exists. Stored 20150530 (qe+60d default) predates the tape itself - the 99c look-ahead class. The 99 floor (max(qe+45d, firstBar) = 20150811) is NOT used here because its prospectus-public argument fails: the RHP carried audited FY15 ANNUAL financials, not the Q4 quarterly split. Measured first availability of the quarterly figure: the Dec-2015 filing (BSE ann 2016-01-21 18:22, Rs mn) prints FY15 annual 1,750 AND 9M-FY15 1,194 in adjacent columns - Q4FY15 = 556 = 55.6cr emerges from that ONE public document by subtraction (same annual-minus-siblings convention as the repo's own Q4 derivations); printed outright as the audited corresponding column on 2016-04-26. Gated next-day of the first source = 20160122.

Pre-listing quarter (quarter ended before the 2015-08-11 listing; measured: NO Jun-2015 result filing exists - the BSE Result announcement list for 539268 starts 2015-10-20, and detres qtr 86.00 returns an empty no-dateend shell). The stored 20150814 is the qe+45d convention and happens to be 3 days after listing, but the value (as-filed 43.64, healed via fund_cell_fix.json) was first printed in the Sep-2015 filing's 'Preceding 3 months' column, broadcast 2015-10-20 19:14. Gated next-day = 20151021.
fixes.found: SYNGENE whole-row heal 2026-08-24 (runbook 108); the FAV14 handoff note flagged this quarter's value (ours 46.6 vs MC 43.6)

fixes.why: SPENCERS (Spencer's Retail) listed 2019-01-25 after demerger from CESC; Jun-2018 predates its tape, so no own Q1FY19 filing was ever published. The cell's ann is the 0 UNKNOWN sentinel, which makes a CORRECT value invisible to the engine. VALUES VERIFIED, NOT CHANGED: its Q1FY20 filing (14-Aug-2019, OutcomeofBM.pdf) prints Profit after tax 0.93 | 2.79 | 2.22 | 7.94 (standalone, Rs crore) and 'Profit/(loss) after tax' (2.46) | 1.83 | 0.62 | 2.39 (consolidated) under Quarter ended 30-Jun-2019 | 31-Mar-2019 | 30-Jun-2018 | Year 31-Mar-2019 - col 3 equals our stored std 2.22 and con 0.62 EXACTLY, and col 2 reproduces our stored Mar-2019 2.79/1.83. FIRST PUBLIC APPEARANCE of the Jun-2018 quarter is therefore that filing. Announcement 14-Aug-2019 14:58 (board outcome 14:10), both before 15:30 so the 12 gate keeps the same day -> 20190814. Self-consistent with the rest of the row: its Sep-2018/Dec-2017 cells carry ann 20190219 (Q3FY19 filing) and Mar-2018 carries 20190517 (Q4FY19), i.e. each pre-listing quarter is dated at the post-listing filing that first printed it. 99 floor satisfied: 20190814 >= first bar 20190125.

CONSERVATIVE BY CONSTRUCTION: the company filed on EMERGE earlier, so the true first disclosure may predate this, but 99 requires ann >= first bar (20190715) and a later date can only ever cost visibility, never create look-ahead.
